name: Make America Great Again
summary: Make America Great Again (MAGA) is the programme of Donald Trump's movement: put the interests of the United States and its citizens first through tariffs, strict immigration enforcement, domestic manufacturing, fossil-fuel production, a strong military and patriotic education. It is hostile to globalism, free-trade deals and open borders, and presents the political establishment as corrupt. Its own sources are firm on trade, immigration, security and sovereignty and say little on much else.
scope: MAGA as a political programme as Cambridge Dictionary defines it (a movement or set of ideas putting the interests of the US and its native-born people first, through tariffs and strict immigration controls) and as set out by its own texts: Trump's 2016 to 2018 speeches and the 2024 Republican platform written 'to Make America Great Again'. It leaves out the separate doctrines of the Claremont, postliberal and national-conservative thinkers that Field and Freedman describe as factions inside the movement, and other writers' views.
